paragraphs: American Realty Investors, Inc. (the "Company"), a Nevada Corporation, is a fully integrated externally managed real estate company. We operate high quality multifamily and commercial properties throughout the Southern United States. We also invest in mortgage notes receivable and in land that is either held for appreciation or development. As used herein, the terms "ARL", "the Company", "We", "Our", or "Us" refer to the Company.

As of December 31, 2025, we owned approximately 78.4% of the common stock of Transcontinental Realty Investors, Inc. ("TCI") and substantially all of our operations are conducted through TCI, whose common stock is traded on the New York Stock Exchange ("NYSE") under the symbol "TCI". Accordingly, we include TCI's financial results in our consolidated financial statements. In addition, as of December 31, 2025, TCI owned approximately 84.6% of the common stock of Income Opportunity Realty Investors, Inc. ("IOR") a Nevada corporation, which is publicly listed and traded on the NYSE American under the symbol IOR.

Realty Advisors, Inc. ("RAI"), a Nevada corporation, owns approximately 90.8% of our common stock. As described in Part III, Item 13. "Certain Relationships and Related Transactions, and Director Independence", our officers and directors also serve as officers and directors of TCI. TCI has business objectives similar to ours. Our officers and directors owe fiduciary duties to both TCI and us under applicable law. In determining whether a particular investment opportunity will be allocated to TCI or to us, management considers the respective investment objectives of each company, the ability to purchase and/or finance the asset and the appropriateness of a particular investment in light of each company's existing real estate and mortgage notes receivable portfolio. To the extent that any particular investment opportunity is appropriate to more than one of the entities, the investment opportunity may be allocated to the entity which has had funds available for investment for the longest period of time, or, if appropriate, the investment may be shared among all or two of the entities.

Our business is managed by Pillar Income Asset Management, Inc. ("Pillar") in accordance with an Advisory Agreement and a Cash Management Agreement that are reviewed annually by our Board of Directors. Pillar is wholly-owned by RAI. Pillar's duties include, but are not limited to, locating, evaluating and recommending real estate-related investment opportunities. Pillar also arranges our debt and equity financing with third party lenders and investors. In addition, Pillar serves as the contractual "Advisor" and "Cash Manager" to TCI and IOR. Pillar is compensated by us under an Advisory Agreement and a Cash Management Agreement that are more fully described in Part III, Item 10. "Directors, Executive Officers and Corporate Governance – The Advisor". We have no employees. We rely upon the employees of Pillar to render services to us in accordance with the terms of the Advisory Agreement and the Cash Management Agreement.

In addition, as described in Part III, Item 13. "Certain Relationships and Related Transactions, and Director Independence", we compete with related parties of Pillar having similar investment objectives related to the acquisition, development, disposition, leasing and financing of real estate and real estate-related investments. In resolving any potential conflicts of
interest which may arise, Pillar has informed us that it intends to exercise its best judgment as to what is fair and reasonable under the circumstances in accordance with applicable law.
At December 31, 2025, our property portfolio consisted of: •Thirteen multifamily properties in operation, comprising 2,128 units;
•Three multifamily properties in lease-up, comprising 672 units; •One multifamily property under development, comprising 234 units;
•Commercial properties, consisting of four office buildings with an aggregate of approximately 1,001,549 rentable square feet; and
•Approximately 1,792 acres of developed and undeveloped land.

•On March 25, 2025, we received $3.5 million in proceeds from a condemnation settlement that provided for the conveyance of 11.2 acres from our holdings in Windmill Farms, resulting in a gain on sale of $3.1 million.

•On October 10, 2025, we sold Villas at Bon Secour, a 200 unit multifamily property in Gulf Shores, Alabama, for $28.0 million (See "Financing Activities"), resulting in a gain on sale of $12.2 million.
•During the year ended December 31, 2025, we sold 72 single family lots from our holdings in Windmill Farms for $3.3 million, resulting in a gain on sale of $2.6 million.
•On May 30, 2025, we paid off the $10.8 million loan on 770 South Post Oak with cash on hand.

headings: Our operating performance is subject to risks associated with the real estate industry.
We may not be able to compete successfully with other entities that operate in our industry.
Real estate investments are illiquid, and we may not be able to sell properties if and when it is appropriate to do so.
Our business may be impacted as a result of any health emergency.
A shift toward remote or hybrid work could reduce demand for office space and adversely affect our office portfolio and financial performance.
Our reliance on third-party management companies to operate certain of our properties may harm our business.
Our property insurance coverage is limited, and any uninsured losses could cause us to lose part or all of our investment in our insured properties.
We may experience increased operating costs which could adversely affect our financial results and the value of our properties.
We face risks associated with property acquisitions.
We engage in development and redevelopment activities with respect to certain of our properties. To the extent that we do so, we are subject to certain risks, including the following:
Many of our properties are concentrated in our primary markets and we may suffer economic harm as a result of adverse conditions in those markets.
We are leveraged and may not be able to meet our debt service obligations.
A significant portion of our debt is insured with HUD.
An increase in interest rates would increase interest costs on variable rate debt and could adversely impact the ability to refinance existing debt.
Unbudgeted capital expenditures or cost overruns could adversely affect business operations and cash flow.
Properties may need to be sold from time to time for cash flow purposes.
Ownership through partnerships and joint ventures could limit property performance.
We could incur more debt.
paragraphs: The following discusses those risk factors that we believe could have a material effect on our business, operations and financial condition. If any of these risks, as well as other risks and uncertainties that we have not yet identified or that we currently believe are not material, become realized, we could be materially adversely affected. In addition, the following risk factors may contain "forward looking statements" and should be read in conjunction with Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial condition and Results of Operations, and the financial statements and related notes in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. All investors should carefully consider the following risk factors in conjunction with the other information in this report before trading our securities.
Real estate investments are subject to various risks, fluctuations and cycles in value and demand, many of which are beyond our control. These events include, but are not limited to:
•adverse changes in international, national or local economic conditions;
•inability to rent space on favorable terms, including possible market pressures to offer tenants rent abatements, tenant
improvements, early termination rights or below-market renewal options;
•adverse changes in financial conditions of actual or potential investors, buyers, sellers or tenants;

paragraphs: The following discussion should be read in conjunction with our consolidated financial statements and related notes in Part II, Item 8 of this Report. Our results of operations for the year ended December 31, 2025 were affected by a acquisitions and disposition, refinancing activity, development activity as discussed below.

We are an externally advised and managed real estate investment company that owns a diverse portfolio of income-producing properties and land held for development throughout the Southern United States. Our portfolio of income-producing properties generally includes multifamily residential properties, office buildings and other commercial properties. Our investment strategy includes acquiring existing income-producing properties as well as developing new properties on land already owned or acquired for a specific development project.

Our operations are managed by Pillar in accordance with an Advisory Agreement and a Cash Management Agreement. Pillar's duties include, but are not limited to, locating, evaluating and recommending real estate and real estate-related investment opportunities. Pillar also arranges our debt and equity financing with third party lenders and investors. We rely upon the employees of Pillar to render services to us in accordance with the terms of the Advisory Agreement. Pillar is considered to be a related party due to its ownership by RAI.
The following is a summary of our recent disposition, financing and development activities:
•On December 13, 2024, we sold 30 single family lots from our holdings in Windmill Farms for $1.4 million, resulting in a gain on sale of $1.1 million.

•On March 25, 2025, we received $3.5 million in proceeds from the condemnation settlement that provided for the conveyance of 11.2 acres from our holdings in Windmill Farms, resulting in a gain on sale of $3.1 million.

•On October 10, 2025, we sold Villas at Bon Secour, a 200 unit multifamily property in Gulf Shores, Alabama, for $28.0 million (See "Financing Activities"), resulting in a gain on sale of $12.2 million.
•During the year ended December 31, 2025, we sold 72 lots from our holdings in Windmill Farms for $3.3 million, resulting in a gain on sale of $2.6 million.
•On January 31, 2023, we paid off our $67.5 million of Series C bonds.
•On February 28, 2023, we extended the maturity of our loan on Windmill Farms until February 28, 2024 at a revised interest rate of 7.75%.

•On March 15, 2023, we entered into a $33.0 million construction loan to finance the development of Alera (See "Development Activities") that bears interest at the Secured Overnight Financing Rate ("SOFR") plus 3% and matures on March 15, 2026, with two one-year extension options.
•On May 4, 2023, we paid off the remaining $14.0 million of our Series A Bonds and $28.9 million of our Series B Bonds, which resulted in a loss on early extinguishment of debt of $1.7 million.
•On August 28, 2023, we paid off our $1.2 million loan on Athens.

•On November 6, 2023, we entered into a $25.4 million construction loan to finance the development of Merano (See "Development Activities") that bears interest at prime plus 0.25% and matures on November 6, 2028.

paragraphs: American Realty Investors, Inc. (the "Company"), 一間內華達州公司，為一間完整整合且由外部管理的不動產公司。我們經營高品質的多單位住宅及商業不動產，遍及美國南部地區。我們亦投資於抵押貸款應收款及土地，該土地或為持有以增值或開發之用。如本文所用，"ARL"、"the Company"、"We"、"Our" 或 "Us" 皆指本公司。

截至2025年12月31日，我們持有Transcontinental Realty Investors, Inc. ("TCI") 普通股約78.4%。我們幾乎所有營運皆透過TCI進行，其普通股於紐約證券交易所 ("NYSE") 以符號 "TCI" 交易。因此，我們將TCI的財務結果納入我們的合併財務報表中。此外，截至2025年12月31日，TCI持有Income Opportunity Realty Investors, Inc. ("IOR") 普通股約84.6%，一間內華達州公司，該公司為公開上市並於紐約證券交易所美國板 (NYSE American) 以符號 IOR 交易。

Realty Advisors, Inc. ("RAI"), 一間內華達州公司，持有我們普通股約90.8%。如Part III, Item 13. "Certain Relationships and Related Transactions, and Director Independence" 所述，我們的董事及高階管理人員亦擔任TCI的董事及高階管理人員。TCI的業務目標與我們相似。我們的董事及高階管理人員根據適用法律，對TCI及我們皆負有信義義務。在決定某項投資機會應分配至TCI或我們時，管理層會考量各公司的投資目標、購買及/或融資資產的能力，以及該項投資是否適合各公司現有的不動產及抵押貸款應收款投資組合。若某項投資機會適合多於一個實體，則該投資機會可能分配至資金可投資時間較長的實體，或，如適當，可能由所有或其中兩個實體共同投資。

我們的業務由Pillar Income Asset Management, Inc. ("Pillar") 根據一項顧問契約及一項現金管理契約進行管理，該等契約每年由我們董事會審閱。Pillar為RAI百分之百擁有。Pillar的職責包括，但不限於，尋找、評估及推薦與不動產相關的投資機會。Pillar亦為我們安排與第三方貸款人及投資人的債務及權益融資。此外，Pillar為TCI及IOR的契約 "顧問" 及 "現金管理人"。Pillar根據一項顧問契約及一項現金管理契約由我們支付費用，該等契約在Part III, Item 10. "Directors, Executive Officers and Corporate Governance – The Advisor" 中有更詳細說明。我們沒有員工。我們依賴Pillar的員工根據顧問契約及現金管理契約的條款為我們提供服務。
此外，如Part III, Item 13. "Certain Relationships and Related Transactions, and Director Independence" 所述，我們與Pillar的相關方競爭，這些相關方具有與我們相似的投資目標，涉及不動產及不動產相關投資的取得、開發、處分、租賃及融資。在解決任何可能產生的利益衝突時，
Pillar已告知我們，其意圖根據適用法律，在情況下行使其最佳判斷，以決定何者為公平合理。
截至2025年12月31日，我們的不動產投資組合包含：• 十三處多單位住宅不動產，共2,128戶；
• 三處多單位住宅不動產處於招租階段，共672戶；• 一處多單位住宅不動產處於開發中，共234戶；
•商業不動產，包含四座辦公大樓，總計約 1,001,549 可出租平方英呎；及
•約 1,792 英畝的已開發與未開發土地。
•於 2025 年 3 月 25 日，我們從拆除賠償協議中收到 3.5 百萬美元的資金，該協議規定將 Windmill Farms 的 11.2 英畝土地轉讓給我們，導致銷售獲利 3.1 百萬美元。
•於 2025 年 10 月 10 日，我們以 28.0 百萬美元出售位於阿拉巴馬州 Gulf Shores 的 Villas at Bon Secour，為一處 200 個單位的多戶住宅不動產（詳見 "資金籌措活動"），導致銷售獲利 12.2 百萬美元。
•於 2025 年 12 月 31 日結業年度，我們從 Windmill Farms 的持有地中出售 72 個單戶住宅地塊，獲款 3.3 百萬美元，導致銷售獲利 2.6 百萬美元。
•於 2025 年 5 月 30 日，我們以現金償還 770 South Post Oak 的 10.8 百萬美元貸款。

本公司為一間由外部管理的不動產投資公司，擁有分散於美國南部各州的多樣化收入產生性不動產及待開發土地。我們的收入產生性不動產組合一般包括多戶住宅、辦公室大樓及其他商業不動產。我們的投資策略包括取得現有收入產生性不動產，以及在已擁有或取得特定開發專案的土地上開發新不動產。
我們的營運由Pillar管理，依照顧問契約及現金管理契約進行。Pillar的職責包括，但不僅限於，尋找、評估及推薦不動產及不動產相關投資機會。Pillar亦為我們安排與第三方貸款人及投資人的債務與權益融資。我們依賴Pillar的員工依顧問契約條款為我們提供服務。Pillar被視為關聯公司，因其由RAI所擁有。

•2024年12月13日，我們出售Windmill Farms持有的30筆單戶住宅地，獲款1.4百萬美元，產生出售獲利1.1百萬美元。

•2025年12月31日財年期間，我們出售Windmill Farms持有的72筆地，獲款3.3百萬美元，產生出售獲利2.6百萬美元。

headings: 本公司營運表現受不動產產業相關風險影響。
本公司可能無法成功與同業其他機構競爭。
不動產投資屬流動性低之資產，本公司可能無法在適當時機出售不動產。
本公司業務可能因任何健康危機而受到影響。
向遠距或混合式工作模式轉變可能降低對辦公室空間之需求，並對本公司辦公室資產組合及財務表現產生負面影響。
本公司對第三方管理公司經營部分不動產之依賴可能損害本公司業務。
本公司不動產保險 coverage 有限，任何未投保之損失可能導致本公司損失部分或全部對投保不動產之投資。
本公司可能面臨營運成本增加，此可能對本公司財務結果及不動產價值產生負面影響。
我們面臨與不動產取得相關的風險。
我們針對部分不動產進行開發及再開發活動。若我們確實進行此類活動，則可能面臨某些風險，包括以下各項：
我們的許多不動產集中於主要市場，因此可能因這些市場的不利條件而遭受經濟損失。
我們負擔較高債務，可能無法履行債務償還義務。
我們的大部分債務由HUD投保。
利率上升將提高變動利率債務的利息成本，並可能不利於重新融資現有債務的能力。
未預算的資本支出或成本超支可能不利於營運及現金流。
不動產可能因現金流需求而需不時出售。
透過合資企業及策略聯盟取得之資產可能限制不動產之營運績效。
本公司可能增加更多負債。
paragraphs: 以下討論那些我們認為可能對我們業務、營運及財務狀況產生重大影響的風險因素。若任何這些風險，以及我們尚未識別或目前認為不具重大影響的其他風險與不確定性實現，我們可能遭受重大不利影響。此外，以下風險因素可能包含「預測性陳述」，應與管理層對財務狀況與營運結果的討論與分析，以及本年度10-K表報表中的財務報表及相關附註一併閱讀。所有投資人應在交易我們證券前，仔細考量以下風險因素，並與本報告中的其他資訊一併參考。
房地產投資會面臨各種風險、價值與需求的波動及週期，許多因素超出我們的控制範圍。這些事件包括，但不僅限於：
• 國際、國家或地方經濟條件的惡化變動；
•無法以有利條件租賃空間，包括可能因市場壓力而提供租客租金減免、租客改善、提前終止權利或低於市場水準的續約選項;
•實際或潛在投資人、買家、賣家或租客之財務狀況惡化;
•實際或潛在投資人、買家、賣家或租客之財務狀況惡化;
